records.title: Boston College Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program
records.deadline_display: Early Decision and Regular Decision applicants who submit their BC applications by the November 1 priority scholarship deadline will be considered.

source.raw_extract: The Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program is an undergraduate academic, merit program that annually awards full-tuition scholarships and fully-funded, GPSP-sponsored summer programs to 18 incoming freshman students. Early Decision and Regular Decision applicants who submit their BC applications by the November 1 priority scholarship deadline will be considered. There is no separate application for this scholarship, but please note that only candidates for fall admission will be considered.
source.notes: Both official GPSP pages (home and FAQ) state the deadline as 'November 1' with NO year attached, and describe the programme as awarding 'annually'. Per brief section 6 an ANNUAL/recurring value must never be converted to a calendar date, so deadline_date stays null and the wording is preserved verbatim. Deliberately did NOT date this as 2026-11-01: the scholarship's own pages never state a year, and the FAQ only points readers to the general Boston College Admission page for deadlines, which is a general admissions deadline and is not admissible evidence for this scholarship (brief section 5). Cross-check quote from the official GPSP FAQ page: 'To apply to be a Boston College Presidential Scholar you must apply by the priority scholarship deadline of November 1. No separate application is required and you may apply as an Early Decision I, Early Decision II or as a Regular Decision applicant. All applicants who apply by the deadline are automatically considered for the Scholarship.'

source.raw_extract: The Temasek Undergraduate Local Scholarship is offered to polytechnic graduates enrolling in STEM programmes at the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT). SIT's focus on industry-centric education aligns well with Temasek's broader goal of plugging skills gap and supporting the development of a resilient workforce in Singapore.
source.notes: UNKNOWN is the truthful result. The official Temasek scholarship hub page (the record's official_source_url) describes the local scholarship but publishes NO application deadline, window, intake or date of any kind. The scholarship's own sub-page redirects to the administering institution, Singapore Institute of Technology: https://www.singaporetech.edu.sg/admissions/scholarships/bond-free-scholarship/temasek-scholarship (HTTP 200), which also publishes no deadline, no application window and no date. SIT's linked 'Terms and Conditions of the Award' page (https://www.singaporetech.edu.sg/admissions/scholarships/terms-and-conditions-award, 'Updated as of 25 February 2026') covers award value, CGPA, bond and repayment only, with no application deadline. SIT's only application entry point on the scholarship page is a generic 'Apply Now' link to the SITLearner admissions portal (https://learner.singaporetech.edu.sg/), which is a general admissions application and not this scholarship's deadline, so it was not used. Confidence LOW refers to the value: there is no value to establish. Nothing was inferred from the Temasek Overseas Scholarship's separate published window, which is a different scholarship.

rejected_sources.reason: Generic SIT undergraduate admissions application portal. A general admissions deadline for a different process is not admissible evidence for this scholarship (brief section 5); no scholarship-specific deadline was published there.

records.title: Flanders Trainee Programme (Flanders Traineeship Programme)
records.deadline_display: You can submit your grant application up to six months in advance until one day before the start of your internship.

source.publisher: Government of Flanders (Departement Buitenlandse Zaken) - Flanders.be
source.as_of: live programme page at retrieval; no cycle year stated for the rule itself
source.raw_extract:
Deadline

You can submit your grant application up to six months in advance until one day before the start of your internship.

You can also apply if your internship has already started. However, you will only be paid for the remaining period of your internship. ... As long as there is budget available

In principle, you can apply for a grant at any time of the year, but you can only get a grant if there is still budget available. If a budget is no longer available for the current year, it will be clearly announced on this website.
source.exact_deadline_wording: In principle, you can apply for a grant at any time of the year, but you can only get a grant if there is still budget available.
source.notes: The programme publishes an explicitly rolling rule with no fixed calendar deadline: apply any time of year, up to six months before and until one day before the internship start, subject to remaining budget. Per brief section 6 this must never be converted into a calendar date, so deadline_date stays null. IMPORTANT open-status caveat, taken verbatim from the programme landing page (https://www.vlaanderen.be/en/studying/flanders-trainee-programme): 'No more grants for 2026' / 'You can no longer apply for a grant for internships continuing into 2026. There is no more budget available for 2026.' / 'A budget will be available again in 2027. You can reapply for internships taking place in 2027 as from January 2027.' So although the deadline semantics are a clean ROLLING recovery, the record's open/upcoming status does not match the programme's current state: the 2026 budget is exhausted and applications only reopen 'as from January 2027'. 'January 2027' is a reopening month with no day given, so it was NOT dated and NOT used as a deadline. Recommend a separate status review of this record (shard already flags verification_status needs_review).

records.open_status_caveat: closed_for_2026_budget; applications for 2027 internships reopen 'as from January 2027' (month-level only, not dated)

source.raw_extract:
3.1 Applications can be submitted online throughout the year.

3.2 The applications should be uploaded at least three months before the due date of the Conference followed by the hard copy of the application.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applications can be submitted online throughout the year.
source.notes: The official ICSSR scheme page states an explicitly rolling rule, so semantics are ROLLING with deadline_date null and must never be dated. The 'three months before the due date of the Conference' requirement is a relative lead time against each applicant's own conference due date, not a calendar deadline, and was therefore not converted into a date. Supporting verbatim: '3.3 The application will not be entertained or considered in any case after participation and presentation of paper in the Conference.' Note the shard carried deadline_precision 'varies' for this record; the live page's own wording supports ROLLING, and no second credible source gives a conflicting calendar deadline, so CONFLICTING does not apply.
